A contemporary solution for rapid radiation removal, conveniently packaged in special injectors that some medics find handy to reuse. Do not dispose of the injector!
 
 %c[ui_gray_3]HEALING:
 %c[d_red] • %c[ui_gray_2] Depletes 5%hp on use

 %c[d_blue] • %c[ui_gray_2] fast usage (syringe)

A dressing to stop bleeding, possibly even sterile. Handy for bandaging wounds, stopping arterial bleeding, and preventing infection.
 
 %c[ui_gray_3]PROPERTIES:
 %c[d_blue] • %c[ui_gray_2] first-aid item
 %c[d_blue] • %c[ui_gray_2] fast usage (adhesive plaster)

The second generation of a strength-enhancing drug. It effectively raises the fatigue threshold of muscles, enhancing their ability to endure prolonged exertion.

A drug intended to partially offset the adverse effects of psi-radiation on humans. One of the few available ways to prevent the inside of your head from getting fried.
 
 %c[ui_gray_3]PROPERTIES:
 %c[d_blue] • %c[ui_gray_2] medicine
 %c[d_red] • %c[ui_gray_2] causes extreme dizziness

Enhances blood coagulation, accelerates wounbd healing, and reduces the likelihood of severe bleeding. Rumor has it that bloodsuckers tend to steer clear of those who regularly abuse this drug.
 
 %c[ui_gray_3]PROPERTIES:
 %c[d_red] • %c[ui_gray_2] causes dizziness

Даже если срок годности аптечек истек, они способны оказать базовую первую помощь, но ожидание чего-то большего может быть смертельно опасным.

В этом наборе есть все необходимое для лечения осколков, пулевых ранений и других боевых травм. К счастью, благодаря присутствию в Зоне ВМСФ, любой желающий может получить эти наборы.
